questions.prompt: In the shared responsibility model, what is AWS responsible for?

options.text: Security OF the cloud — the infrastructure, hardware, and managed-service software
Security IN the cloud — your data and access configuration

questions.explanation: AWS secures the cloud itself: physical data centers, hardware, networking, and the software of managed services. The customer secures what they put in the cloud.

questions.prompt: Match each task to who is responsible.
questions.explanation: The customer owns the guest OS and access configuration; AWS owns the physical facilities and the virtualization/host layer.

questions.prompt: An S3 bucket is misconfigured as public and data leaks. Whose responsibility is that?

options.text: The customer, because access configuration and data are theirs to secure

questions.explanation: Even though AWS runs S3 securely, the bucket's access configuration and the data are the customer's responsibility. Misconfiguration is the leading cause of cloud exposure.

questions.prompt: Which items are always the CUSTOMER's responsibility, regardless of service? Select all that apply.

options.text: Their IAM users, roles, and policies (access configuration)
The physical security of the data centers

questions.explanation: Data, access configuration, and encryption choices are always the customer's. Physical data-center security is always AWS's.

questions.prompt: Compared with EC2, a fully managed service like S3 or Lambda leaves the customer the ____ amount of infrastructure work (one word: least or most).
questions.explanation: Serverless/fully managed services leave the customer the least infrastructure work, because AWS runs and patches all of it — though data and access are still the customer's.

questions.prompt: What is a 'shared control' in the model?

options.text: A duty both parties handle at different layers, such as patch management
A control that is never needed

questions.explanation: Shared controls are split by layer: AWS patches the infrastructure while the customer patches the guest OS and apps; configuration management and training are similar.
